SAMBudgetMetadata.description: Smarter API Budget Manifest - Metadata class.

annotations.description:
The manifest annotations. Used for storing arbitrary metadata as
            key-value pairs. Example: [{'smarter.sh/test-manifest/project-name': 'Scooby dooby do'}]. The
            key should be a valid url-friendly string. The value accepts
            multi-line string values (YAML block scalars) and various scalar types including
            str, int, float, bool, datetime.date, datetime.datetime, decimal.Decimal, uuid.UUID, bytes, list, dict.
annotations.title: Annotations

description.description: The description for this resource. Be brief. Keep it under 255 characters.
description.title: Description

name.description: The camelCase name of the manifest resource
name.title: Name

tags.description: The tags of the manifest. Used for generic resource categorization and search. Example: ['tag1', 'tag2']
tags.title: Tags

version.description: The semantic version of the manifest. Example: 0.1.0
version.title: Version

SAMBudgetMetadata.title: SAMBudgetMetadata

config.description: Budget.spec.config[object]. The limits of the Budget.

resources.description: Budget.spec.resources[list]. The resources that the Budget is enforced on. Resources that are removed from the list are detached.
resources.title: Resources

SAMBudgetSpecConfig.description: Smarter API Budget Manifest Budget.spec.config: the budget's limits.

absoluteLimit.description: Budget.spec.config.absoluteLimit: the most that may be spent in total, from when the budget is attached. 0 means no limit.
absoluteLimit.title: Absolutelimit

action.description: Budget.spec.config.action: block further charges when a limit is reached, or only warn.
action.title: Action

duration.description: Budget.spec.config.duration: the billing periods, from when the budget is attached, after which it no longer applies. 0 means never.
duration.title: Duration

message.description: Budget.spec.config.message: what people are told when the budget blocks their request. Defaults to a description of the limit that was reached.
message.title: Message

period.description: Budget.spec.config.period: the billing period of periodicLimit and duration.
period.title: Period

periodicLimit.description: Budget.spec.config.periodicLimit: the most that may be spent in a billing period. 0 means no limit.
periodicLimit.title: Periodiclimit

unit.description: Budget.spec.config.unit: what the limits measure: cost in USD, or total tokens.
unit.title: Unit

warningThreshold.description: Budget.spec.config.warningThreshold: the percentage of a limit at which a warning is sent. 0 means never.
warningThreshold.title: Warningthreshold

SAMBudgetSpecConfig.title: SAMBudgetSpecConfig

SAMBudgetSpecResource.description:
Smarter API Budget Manifest Budget.spec.resources[]: a resource that the budget is enforced on.

Either kind and name, with an optional accountNumber, or a recordLocator.

accountNumber.description: Budget.spec.resources.accountNumber: the account that the resource belongs to. Defaults to your own.
accountNumber.title: Accountnumber

kind.description: Budget.spec.resources.kind: the resource's manifest kind, e.g. LLMClient.
kind.title: Kind

name.description: Budget.spec.resources.name: the resource's name. For an Account, its account number; for a User, the username.
name.title: Name

recordLocator.description: Budget.spec.resources.recordLocator: any resource's record locator, e.g. llmclient-rc2x, in place of kind and name.
recordLocator.title: Recordlocator

SAMBudgetSpecResource.title: SAMBudgetSpecResource

SAMBudgetStatus.description:
Smarter API Budget Manifest - Status class.

Read only.

created.description: The date in which this resource was created. Read only.
created.title: Created

dependencies.description: dependencies[List]: The resources that depend on this resource, and that must be deleted, or stop referring to it, before it can be deleted. Lists only the resources that you can read. Read only.
dependencies.title: Dependencies

modified.description: The date in which this resource was most recently changed. Read only.
modified.title: Modified

recordLocator.description: recordLocator[String]: An optional identifier used to locate the resource record associated with this manifest. Read only.
recordLocator.title: Recordlocator

resources.description: Budget.status.resources: the budget versus the actual spending of each resource. Read only.
resources.title: Resources

SAMBudgetStatus.title: SAMBudgetStatus

SAMBudgetStatusResource.description:
The budget versus the actual spending of one of the budget's resources.

Read only.

absolutePercent.description: Budget.status.resources.absolutePercent: absoluteActual, as a percentage of the limit.
absolutePercent.title: Absolutepercent

expiresAt.description: Budget.status.resources.expiresAt: when the budget's duration ends.
expiresAt.title: Expiresat

isActive.description: Budget.status.resources.isActive: whether the budget is enforced on it.
isActive.title: Isactive

isLocked.description: Budget.status.resources.isLocked: whether the budget refuses further charges.
isLocked.title: Islocked

periodicPercent.description: Budget.status.resources.periodicPercent: periodicActual, as a percentage of the limit.
periodicPercent.title: Periodicpercent

startDate.description: Budget.status.resources.startDate: when the budget was attached.
startDate.title: Startdate
